# Kind-3 interaction roster fixture

This directory contains public test material generated by
`core/dilla-core/tests/interaction_roster_fixture.rs`. Regenerate it from the repository root with:

```sh
cd core
cargo test -p dilla-core --test interaction_roster_fixture -- --ignored --nocapture
```

The writer creates a real OpenMLS kind-3 group carrying the exact 12-field v2
`DillaInteractionBinding` encoding, with one native Bot leaf and one native human participant leaf.
It also writes an independently authenticated three-leaf group as the extra-member negative case.
The metadata records stable account, device, group, installation and scope IDs, the encoded binding,
public DSK/SSK values, and expected roster cardinality. The MLS cryptographic tree and GroupInfo
contain ephemeral OpenMLS key material, so rerunning the writer replaces those public binary files
with a fresh valid group; it never writes private keys.

Files:

- `group_info.mls`, `ratchet_tree.mls`: two-member authenticated group.
- `extra.group_info.mls`, `extra.ratchet_tree.mls`: three-member authenticated group with the same
  admitted Bot and participant plus an extra human leaf.
- `*_credential.cbor`: signed Dilla credential identities for the admitted Bot and participant.
- `*_device_list.cbor`: SSK-signed one-device lists for the admitted Bot and participant.
- `metadata.json`: stable admission and credential verification inputs.
